source.paper: What kinds of contracts do ML APIs need?

nodes.name: Single API Method
nodes.definition: A behavioral precondition or postcondition involving a single API method.
inclusion_criteria: The obligation constrains one API method.

nodes.name: Data Type
nodes.definition: A type constraint on an API argument.
inclusion_criteria: An argument must have an accepted type.

nodes.name: Primitive Type
nodes.definition: A single API method constrains an argument to a primitive type.
inclusion_criteria: Primitive types such as string, integer, float, boolean, number, or None.
exclusion_criteria: Built-in compound, reference, or ML-specific types.

nodes.name: Built-in Type
nodes.definition: A single API method requires a built-in compound type.
inclusion_criteria: List, dictionary, tuple, or ordinary array constraints.
exclusion_criteria: Primitive, referenced object/function/class, or ML tensor dtype constraints.

nodes.name: Reference Type
nodes.definition: An argument requires a referenced object, function, or class-typed value.
inclusion_criteria: Internal or external class objects, instances, or callable functions.
exclusion_criteria: Primitive, built-in compound, or ML tensor dtype constraints.

nodes.name: ML Type
nodes.definition: An argument requires an ML-domain tensor or multidimensional-array type or dtype.
inclusion_criteria: Tensor types or ML-specific uniform dtypes such as float32 or complex64.
exclusion_criteria: Framework objects merely associated with LLM or ML systems.

nodes.name: Boolean Expression Type
nodes.definition: A logical or value assertion involving API arguments.
inclusion_criteria: Comparisons or logical combinations constrain argument values.

nodes.name: Intra-argument Contract
nodes.definition: A logical or value constraint on one argument of one API method.
inclusion_criteria: One argument must satisfy a value, range, format, or logical constraint.
exclusion_criteria: Relationships across two or more arguments or across distinct methods/components.

nodes.name: Inter-argument Contract
nodes.definition: A relationship across two or more arguments of the same API method.
inclusion_criteria: Arguments of one call must match or jointly satisfy a relation.
exclusion_criteria: Dependencies between components or different API methods.

nodes.name: API Method Order
nodes.definition: A temporal constraint involving multiple API calls.
inclusion_criteria: The obligation requires a genuine method-call ordering.
exclusion_criteria: Future-tense wording without a temporal call-order constraint.

nodes.name: Always
nodes.definition: An always-required temporal API ordering or obligation in its applicable execution context.
inclusion_criteria: A required order must hold whenever the execution context applies.
exclusion_criteria: An obligation that only needs to occur at some later execution point.

nodes.name: Eventually
nodes.definition: A method call or ordering obligation must occur at a subsequent point in execution.
inclusion_criteria: After a triggering state or call, another call must occur eventually.

nodes.name: Hybrid
nodes.definition: A blend of behavioral and temporal contracts or a selection among contract forms.
inclusion_criteria: Behavior and call order depend on each other, or explicit alternatives satisfy an obligation.
exclusion_criteria: A single behavioral or temporal obligation without dependency or alternatives.

nodes.name: SAM-AMO Interdependency
nodes.definition: A behavior, argument, or state condition and API-call order constrain each other.
inclusion_criteria: State or argument conditions determine call order, or call order requires a condition.
exclusion_criteria: Independent co-occurrence of behavioral and temporal concepts.

nodes.name: Selection
nodes.definition: A choice among alternative ways to satisfy one API contract.
inclusion_criteria: The contract states explicit acceptable alternatives.
exclusion_criteria: A conjunction of requirements without choice.

nodes.name: Selection - SAM alternatives
nodes.definition: Multiple acceptable behavioral or SAM ways can satisfy the obligation.
inclusion_criteria: All explicit alternatives are SAM-level behavioral forms.
exclusion_criteria: Temporal alternatives or mixed behavioral/temporal alternatives.

nodes.name: Selection - AMO alternatives
nodes.definition: Multiple acceptable temporal or API-order ways can satisfy the obligation.
inclusion_criteria: All explicit alternatives are AMO-level forms.
exclusion_criteria: Behavioral alternatives or mixed behavioral/temporal alternatives.

nodes.name: Selection - SAM and AMO alternatives
nodes.definition: Behavioral and temporal/order forms are alternatives for satisfying one obligation.
inclusion_criteria: At least one SAM alternative and one AMO alternative are explicit choices.
exclusion_criteria: A behavior/order dependency or alternatives within only one family.
